name: @engenox/cedar
description: The two-pass Cedar policy gate + the dial ledger (12 §9; CLAUDE.md §2: Cedar, NOT OPA, for the dial gate; <2ms p99 is a CI test, 23 §3m). The DIAL candor invariants ride here: default `propose`; an escalation requires 3 axes (a watchdog hit if fewer, CLAUDE.md §8); demotion-on-alert; deadlock auto-demotion (26 §6). Runs the REAL Cedar runtime via @cedar-policy/cedar-wasm (the gate mechanism is NEVER thinned per the ADR-0007 Thinning Rule) — NOT a symbolic stub. The warm-eval p99 is the <2ms assertion; cold WASM init is amortized, not faked.
